fds_sections.Business Context:
Project Background
FreshBasket aims to improve its service offering by launching a mobile application that allows customers to order groceries online, catering to the increasing demand for digital grocery services.
Business Needs
The need for a mobile platform arises from changing consumer behaviors and the necessity for FreshBasket to remain competitive in the grocery retail market.
Objectives
To provide a seamless grocery ordering experience.
To enable secure and efficient payment processing.
To facilitate effective order management for store managers.
Expected Benefits
Enhanced customer satisfaction and retention.
Increased sales through online orders.
Improved operational efficiency for inventory management.

Functional Design Specification Document (FDS)

1. Document Control

2. Executive Summary
The FreshBasket mobile application aims to provide customers with a convenient platform to order groceries directly from their mobile devices. The application will facilitate the browsing of products, management of shopping carts, and secure payment processing, while allowing store managers to oversee incoming orders and inventory. With a user-friendly interface and robust features, the app seeks to enhance the grocery shopping experience for users in Hyderabad.

3. Introduction
Purpose
The purpose of this document is to provide a detailed Functional Design Specification for the FreshBasket mobile application, including the functional and non-functional requirements, user workflows, and system integration points.

Project Scope
This project involves the development of a mobile application for grocery ordering, focusing on customer usability, order management, and integration with payment gateways.

System Overview
The FreshBasket application will consist of a customer-facing mobile app and an admin panel for store managers. The system will support user authentication, product browsing, cart management, order processing, and inventory management.

4. Business Context
Project Background
FreshBasket aims to improve its service offering by launching a mobile application that allows customers to order groceries online, catering to the increasing demand for digital grocery services.

Business Needs
The need for a mobile platform arises from changing consumer behaviors and the necessity for FreshBasket to remain competitive in the grocery retail market.

Objectives
To provide a seamless grocery ordering experience.
To enable secure and efficient payment processing.
To facilitate effective order management for store managers.

Expected Benefits
Enhanced customer satisfaction and retention.
Increased sales through online orders.
Improved operational efficiency for inventory management.

5. Stakeholder Analysis
| Stakeholder | Role | Responsibilities | Interests |
|--------------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------|
| Customers | End Users | Order groceries via mobile app | Usability, convenience |
| Store Managers | Admin Users | Manage orders and inventory | Order visibility, efficiency |
| IT Team | Development/Support | Build and maintain the application | Technical success |
| Marketing Team | Promotion | Promote the app to customers | Customer engagement |
| Business Analysts | Requirement Gathering | Gather and document requirements | Clear documentation |

6. System Overview Diagram
mermaid
graph TD
A[Customer Mobile App] -->|Order| B[Online Payment Gateway]
A -->|Browse Products| C[Product Catalog]
A -->|Manage Cart| D[Shopping Cart]
B -->|Payment Confirmation| E[Admin Panel]
E -->|View Orders| F[Store Managers]
F -->|Update Status| C

7. Functional Requirements
| FR Code | Description |
|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| FR-001 | The app must allow customers to order groceries from their mobile devices. |
| FR-002 | The app must provide a product catalog for customers to browse available items. |
| FR-003 | The app must include a cart functionality for customers to manage their selected items. |
| FR-004 | The app must allow customers to select a delivery time slot for their orders. |
| FR-005 | The app must integrate an online payment gateway for processing customer payments. |
| FR-006 | The app must support user registration and OTP login for customer authentication. |
| FR-007 | Store managers must have access to view all incoming orders through an admin panel. |
| FR-008 | Store managers must be able to update order status and manage inventory through the admin panel. |
| FR-009 | The admin panel must be a lightweight web dashboard accessible without installation. |

8. User Workflows
Customer Ordering Workflow
1. Customer opens the app.
2. Customer browses the product catalog.
3. Customer adds items to the cart.
4. Customer selects a delivery time slot.
5. Customer proceeds to payment.
6. Customer completes the order.

Store Manager Order Management Workflow
1. Store manager logs into the admin panel.
2. Store manager views incoming orders.
3. Store manager updates order status.
4. Store manager manages inventory.

9. Feature Specifications
Feature: Product Catalog
Inputs: User request for products.
Outputs: List of available products.
Business Rules: Products must be updated in real-time.
Validation: Ensure all product details are complete.

Feature: Shopping Cart
Inputs: User adds/removes items.
Outputs: Updated cart summary.
Business Rules: Cart must retain items until checkout.
Validation: Ensure inventory availability for items in the cart.

Feature: Payment Processing
Inputs: User payment information.
Outputs: Payment confirmation.
Business Rules: All transactions must be secure and encrypted.
Validation: Validate card details and availability of funds.

10. Data Requirements
| Field Name | Data Type | Validation Rules | Format |
|------------------|---------------|-----------------------------------|-------------------|
| ProductID | Integer | Must be unique | Numeric |
| ProductName | String | Must not be empty | Alphanumeric |
| Price | Decimal | Must be greater than 0 | Numeric |
| Quantity | Integer | Must be non-negative | Numeric |
| OrderID | Integer | Must be unique | Numeric |
| UserID | Integer | Must correspond to registered user | Numeric |

11. Business Rules
The app will only support orders from the five specified FreshBasket stores in Hyderabad.
Customers must authenticate using OTP for secure access.
Store managers must have distinct access rights to manage orders and inventory.

12. Non-Functional Requirements
Performance: The app must load product pages within 3 seconds.
Security: Must implement OTP-based authentication for secure user login.
Scalability: The app should support up to 10,000 simultaneous users.
Usability: The app must be user-friendly for customers who may not be tech-savvy.

13. User Interface Requirements
Screen Layouts: The app will have a home screen, product catalog, cart screen, and payment screen.
Navigation Flow: Users can navigate between the catalog, cart, and checkout with a bottom navigation bar.
UI Behavior: The app must provide feedback upon actions (e.g., item added to cart).

14. Integration Points
Payment Gateway: Integration with a secure online payment service.
Inventory Management System: Real-time updates on product availability.
User Authentication Service: For OTP generation and verification.

15. Assumptions & Constraints
Assumptions: Customers are more comfortable with OTP login than email-based authentication.
Constraints: The app must comply with local regulations regarding online payments and data privacy.

16. Risks & Mitigation
| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation Strategy |
|-------------------------------|------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Technical challenges in app development | Medium | High | Use agile development practices and regular testing. |
| Low user adoption | Medium | High | Implement a marketing strategy to promote the app. |
| Security breaches | Low | High | Employ strong security protocols and regular audits. |

17. Acceptance Criteria
The app must allow users to successfully place an order.
Users must be able to navigate the product catalog without issues.
The payment process must be completed without errors.
Store managers must be able to view and manage orders.
